reason: A Harness channel plugin that connects Feishu and Lark conversations to Harness Agent sessions, including threaded session mapping, configurable access controls, and agent-generated replies.

summaries.zh: 将飞书或 Lark 的单聊、群聊和话题消息接入 Harness Agent，并通过持久化会话返回智能体回复的渠道插件。
summaries.en: A channel plugin that connects Feishu and Lark chats and threads to Harness Agent sessions and returns agent-generated replies.

capabilities: Receives Feishu/Lark messages over a WebSocket connection
Sends agent-generated replies to Feishu/Lark chats and threads
Maps chats and threads to persistent Harness sessions
Invokes the configured Harness Agent, model, workspace, preset, and tools
Stores or reads Feishu/Lark application credentials through Harness configuration
